title: Stainless Steel Motor Lock – Locks the Outboard Mounting Screws
seo_title: Stainless Steel Motor Lock for Outboards
seo_description: Stainless steel motor lock that secures the outboard's mounting screws. 2 keys included, and the key ring floats if it ends up in the water.
descriptionHtml:
The thought that your motor could be gone by tomorrow morning

The outboard is held on by a few mounting screws that can be loosened with the right tool in a few minutes, and the boat often sits unattended at the dock overnight. Making sure everything is still in place before you head home rarely feels completely safe.

A stainless steel lock over the mounting screws

The stainless steel motor lock fits over the outboard's mounting screws and is locked with one of the two keys included. The key ring floats. If you drop it in the water by the boat, it bobs up instead of sinking.

Features

  • The mounting screws can't be unscrewed without the key – the stainless steel lock covers the screws that hold the motor.
  • If you drop the key in the water, it floats up – the key ring floats.
  • Two keys included – one for you, one as a spare.
  • Made to stay out by the dock – the lock is made of stainless steel.
